leadText: Pocket Adventure (Japanese: ポケットに冒険をつめこんで Pack Your Pocket With Adventure) is the tenth and final episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on December 22, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
